text:
Morgan: Heads-up — planning a surgical prune of admin/KMS grants on the prod keyring tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: remove service accounts with no decrypts in 90 days, preserve rollback metadata, and run a 48h canary on a small subset. Tagging @Carla @Leo for infra/SRE sync. Any blockers?

Carla: SGTM from security side. Two asks: 1) capture full audit payloads for the time window, 2) send proposed removal list to security for a quick owner sanity check.

Leo: +1. Can we define the canary as: keep 5% of binds across projects for 48h and monitor decrypt_error_rate and latency? If decrypt_error_rate > 5/min for 15m, we roll back. I'll prep dashboards.

Sam: Quick note — a few internal CI service accounts show up in the candidate list. I flagged owners in #eng-infra. Also file a prechange ticket so ops can approve.

ent-bot: Audit export job queued: gs://redwood-audit-exports/prod-keyring/exports/1745673210.csv (includes metadata, timestamps, and principal payload).

Morgan: Thanks. Working plan: export bindings, run local scorer, produce `prune_candidates.csv`, post here for a 2h review window, then prune at 09:00 PT. Rollback metadata saved to `/infra/entitlement-rollbacks/prod-keyring/1745673210.json`.

Morgan: command I used to export and filter last-used (for reproducibility):
```
python tools/rbac/export_bindings.py \
  --keyring prod-keyring \
  --project redwood-prod \
  --unused-days 90 \
  --out /tmp/prune_candidates.json
```

Carla: Please include `--include-payload` on the export so we retain grant context (labels, requestMetadata). Also, mark any bind where `principal` matches `ci-*` or `svc-test-*` as EXEMPT until owners confirm.

Leo: Dashboard plan: track `kms.decrypt.success`, `kms.decrypt.error`, and `instance.cpu` for services tied to pruned principals. Alert criteria: >5 decrypt errors/min sustained for 15m OR >3x baseline latency for 10m. If triggered, run the rollback script: `scripts/entitlements/rollback --meta /infra/entitlement-rollbacks/prod-keyring/1745673210.json`

Sam: FYI — told CI owners to expect a brief flake window. If any prod job fails post-prune, ping #incidents and I'll escalate.

Morgan: Will post the candidate CSV by EOD and ping 15m before the prune. If no objections during the review window, we proceed. :thumbsup:

Carla: Thanks — I'll stand by for the list and run a quick owner sanity check once it's posted.

Leo: I'll finish the dashboard and add the automatic rollback playbook.

ent-bot: Reminder scheduled: prune job will run at 09:00 PT unless a hold message is posted to this thread.

Morgan: Copy — proceeding on schedule, will update with final list.
